scope: isolated PostgreSQL schema; no application records modified

results.name: all payment records, accounting and totals commit together
12 concurrent callbacks create exactly one capture and accounting entry
capture wins over concurrent and delayed terminal/failure callbacks
one captured gateway payment cannot pay a second order
a second payment ID cannot silently replace an already paid order
paise precision and committed state survive a fresh connection
payment failure also rolls back the exact reserved wallet debit

limits: Database restart/power-loss durability was not fault-injected.
External gateway, order conversion and downstream effects are separate transactions.
